initialExam.title: RRB Junior Engineer (JE) 2025-26
initialExam.description: Junior Engineer exam for technical posts in Indian Railways. CBT-1 completed Feb-Mar 2026; CBT-2 scheduled July 2, 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Diploma/Degree in Engineering from recognized institution
initialExam.qualifications: Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch
initialExam.syllabus: CBT-1: Mathematics (30Q), General Intelligence (25Q), General Awareness (15Q), General Science (30Q). CBT-2: Technical subjects based on branch.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT-1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 min. CBT-2: 150 questions, 150 marks, 2 hours.
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Engineer in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, S&T, IT departments of Indian Railways
initialExam.careerGrowth: JE → Senior Section Engineer → Chief Workshop Engineer → higher posts.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form with engineering details 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Free Rail passes, Quarters, Medical, Pension
